reason: The standard Japanese legal and tax term for Permanent Establishment (PE) is 恒久的施設. '常設的施設' is an unnatural literal calque (possibly influenced by Chinese 常设机构) and should not be taught to business Japanese learners.

issues.detail: In Japanese tax law and international business practice, 'Permanent Establishment (PE)' is universally established as 恒久的施設 (こうきゅうてきしせつ). '常設的施設' is non-standard and unnatural.
Sentences use '常設的施設' instead of the standard Japanese tax terminology '恒久的施設'.
Speaker A uses '常設的施設' where native business/tax professionals would exclusively say '恒久的施設' (or simply 'PE').
